name: O.B.System Inc.
summary: O.B.System Inc. is a Japanese system integration company. It offers consultation on systems and writes custom application software for mainframes, workstations, microcontrollers and personal computers, builds open-system network infrastructure, and creates internet and web-based solutions. Its clients span financial, industrial, distribution, public, embedded and medical sectors. Dating from 1972, it has its headquarters in Chuo, Japan.
